# Tool4SaaS (133 free tools across 12 categories + guides)
> Updated: 2026-11-24

> Free, privacy-friendly online productivity and developer tools. Most run entirely in your browser with no account and no upload. Full FAQ + step hints: https://tool4saas.com/llms-full.txt
